title: Granularity from positive dimension
statement: Let $V$ be a finite vector space over $\mathbb F_2$ with positive dimension, and let $f:V\to\{-1,1\}$. Every dual Fourier coefficient of the real-valued function associated to $f$ is an integer multiple of $2(1/2)^{\dim V}$.
